require-files.description: Fail when the caller has no committed K9 file (a zero-file run is otherwise grey, not red).

fail-on-indeterminate.description: Fail the job on an orange grid as well as a red one.

advisory.description: Findings become ::warning:: annotations and the job passes, whatever the verdict (the grid and its artifact are still produced). Governance calls this reusable with it on, so no repository turns red at once; a repository opts into enforcement by calling with advisory: false (the default for direct callers).

grid-author.description: No longer used: the delta column grades the base tree with this lane's own checker and reads no comment. Kept so existing callers keep working.

verdict.description: Grid state: red, orange, yellow, green or grey.

steps.name: checkout the K9 validator, contract and renderer at this workflow's commit
Record which standards commit supplies validator, contract and renderer
steps.run:
# The immutable repository ID survives a transfer or rename, so it is
# the only identity the canon checks (no slug: a slug-only check
# silently flips this to the caller branch after a move).
if [ "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY_ID:-}" = "1116521501" ]; then
  echo "CANON_REF=$HEAD_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
else
  echo "CANON_REF=$WORKFLOW_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
fi

steps.name: Install Nickel (pinned, sha256-verified; one version estate-wide)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
URL="https://github.com/tweag/nickel/releases/download/${NICKEL_VERSION}/nickel-x86_64-linux"
curl -sSfL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --tlsv1.2 --retry 3 -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/nickel" "$URL"
echo "${NICKEL_SHA256}  ${RUNNER_TEMP}/nickel" | sha256sum -c -
chmod +x "$RUNNER_TEMP/nickel"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Install ijson-jcs (3-practice/JSON-POLICY.adoc, D306)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# Best effort: the renderer falls back to jq's sorted compact form,
# byte-identical for its ASCII integer-only documents, and the grid
# records which serialiser ran.
cargo install --quiet --git https://github.com/hyperpolymath/ijson-jcs --rev "$IJSON_JCS_REV" --locked ijson-jcs \
  || echo "::warning::ijson-jcs did not install; report.json falls back to jq -S -c"

steps.name: Renderer regression tests
steps.run:
# In advisory mode a failure is a warning, not a runner error annotation.
set +e
bash scripts/tests/k9-grid-test.sh
status=$?
if [ "$status" -ne 0 ] && [ "$ADVISORY" = "true" ]; then
  echo "::warning::renderer regression tests exited with status $status (advisory; not enforced)"
  exit 0
fi
exit "$status"

steps.name: coordination.k9 validator self-test (v1.2 ABNF through apg-js, fixtures, mutants, v1.1 -> v1.2 side condition)
steps.run:
# In advisory mode a failure is a warning, not a runner error annotation.
set +e
bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun validate.js --self-test
status=$?
if [ "$status" -ne 0 ] && [ "$ADVISORY" = "true" ]; then
  echo "::warning::coordination.k9 validator self-test exited with status $status (advisory; not enforced)"
  exit 0
fi
exit "$status"

steps.name: Enumerate the committed K9 files, the changed files and ledger growth
Validate every committed K9 file (L0–L2, strict)
Validate coordination.k9 files against the v1.2 ABNF (own grid category)
Grade the base tree with this checker (delta column)
Archive the grid and its evidence
Gate
steps.run:
# The script lives in the canon checkout this step may be reporting on, so the
# fallback for its absence is inline: a failed checkout must still say so.
if [ -f "$LANE" ]; then
  bash "$LANE" gate
elif [ "$ADVISORY" = "true" ]; then
  echo "::warning::K9 conformance (advisory): the conformance script could not be staged (a checkout step failed), so conformance did not run; not enforced."
else
  echo "::error::K9 conformance could not run: the conformance script could not be staged (a checkout step failed)"; exit 1
fi
